subject: compute DELTA11 change: implement setThreadgroupMemoryLength fully (no refusal)
body: Lowering confirmed the compiler already supports dynamic threadgroup memory via the translator's SpecKey::TgLength(n) specialization constant (24/24 host checks on real compute_apl/compute_apl_fast/sum_apl... SPIR-V, see lowering's contract post). Record per-index lengths (multiple of 16, <=32768 else refuse), feed them into the planner kernel state before planning so every region gets them (default 0 would undersize), allocate WLS from header word 18 (already implemented). Report maxThreadgroupMemoryLength=32768. Keep the inert compute pipeline item.
